title: AudioPlayerViewModel
description: Create AggregatorApp/Podcasts/AudioPlayerViewModel.swift as an @Observable final class. Init takes episode: PodcastEpisode and store: CredentialsStore. Steps: (1) configure AVAudioSession with .playback category and activate; (2) build CF-Access headers dict from store; (3) guard URL(string: episode.audioUrl) — set playerError=true and return if nil; (4) build AVURLAsset with AVURLAssetHTTPHeaderFieldsKey; (5) build AVPlayerItem and AVPlayer; (6) set player.defaultRate; (7) KVO on item.status capturing real duration on .readyToPlay on main queue; (8) periodic 0.5s time observer updating currentTime when !isSeeking; (9) AVPlayerItem.didPlayToEndTimeNotification resets isPlaying, currentTime=0, seeks to .zero. Expose togglePlayPause(), seek(to:), setSpeed(_:). deinit removes all observers.
acceptance_criteria: currentTime updates every ~0.5s when playing and isSeeking is false
End of episode resets isPlaying to false, currentTime to 0, and seeks to .zero
deinit removes time observer, KVO observation, and notification observer without crashing
playerError set to true when audio URL is malformed
